members.name: Torina Rajkumari
members.bio: Torina is a recent graduate with Bachelors of Science in zoology. A zoology enthusiast who loves incorporating science with the society. She is someone who constantly thrives to be a better human. She inspires to be a great communicator with education being her prime strength and seeks a progressive society. Likes doing craftwork, gardening in her leisure time .
